name: Blueprint
description: Builds a unit out of what is on the floor. It fights for three rounds and then comes apart. Two at a time at most, and one falling is not a party wipe.

name: Teardown
description: Takes a Construct's shell off at the seam. No damage, no roll: the frame is simply removed and whoever is inside is in the open.

name: Tolerances
description: Holds everything on this side inside its tolerances. Nobody goes down for two turns.

name: Field Repair
description: Not medicine. Engineering, applied to a person, which she insists is the same discipline.

name: Open Weights
description: Capstone. Publishes the weights. Every machine on the other side reads them and changes sides for three rounds.
